rows.heading: Search Mode
rows.english: Press A to search. You may find water, food, items, or other supplies. Find nothing? Crew fatigue goes up by 3. Sailors may desert or be attacked by wild animals during a search.

rows.heading: Declare War Mode
rows.english: Pick a fleet or town on screen. Attacking starts a war with its faction and sharply reduces goodwill. You can't declare war on allied fleets.
